preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 2 and 250,000 inclusive.
The number of edges is exactly n-1, forming a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n for a, b, c in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two vertices within the range 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= c <= 10**6 for a, b, c in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge has a positive integer weight between 1 and 1,000,000 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(w, int) and w >= 0 for w in result)
postconditions.description: Each integer in the output is a non-negative integer representing the smallest total weight of edges to be deleted.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(sorted(c for a, b, c in edges if a in deleted or b in deleted) for deleted in [set()] + [set(range(1, n+1)) - set(neighbors) for neighbors in [set()] + [set([v]) for v in range(1, n+1)] + [set([v, w]) for v in range(1, n+1) for w in range(v+1, n+1)]]) == result)
postconditions.description: Each output integer represents the smallest total weight of edges to be deleted so that the degrees of all vertices become less than or equal to the corresponding x.
